content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1).**

Section 11 partly worked already — 11.2 gives thirty-day machine-readable data return (and bars withholding over fee disputes), and 11.3 gives secure deletion plus officer certification. But 11.1 sat at our walk-away position and contradicted both: immediate discontinuation of all assistance, permanent deletion of Customer Data, and express exclusion of export or migration support. It also left Section 10.1's reference to an "agreed transition period" with nothing behind it.

The redline replaces 11.1 only, adding up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and making any deletion subject to the 11.2/11.3 return-and-certification sequence — reaching the preferred position without touching the paragraphs that already comply. Ninety days is flagged in the comment as the fallback.
